description: Mechanically check one public image URL for a segment, without an LLM and without judging relevance (the agent, who sees the image, decides relevance). Returns exactly one code: ok, blocked_403 (the host blocked the SSRF-safe download — retry with upload_media bytes fetched on your own machine), not_image, too_small, too_large, timeout, or wrong_aspect (with videoAspect given: the image cannot fill that frame — send one that matches the aspect; the reply carries its probed width and height). No fake User-Agent or Referer is sent to bypass hotlink blocks, and private addresses are never fetched. The URL never appears in the output.

url.description: Public image URL to check mechanically (no LLM, no relevance judgement).

videoAspect.description: Video aspect the image will fill (9:16 Shorts/Instagram, 16:9 long YouTube, 1:1 square). When given, an image that cannot fill the frame returns wrong_aspect instead of ok — send one that matches the aspect.

name: check_media
